text:
Maya: Heads up — Support flagged a customer seeing a 2x token bill after a streaming response that triggered a tool call then a reconnect. attaching quick logs.
Sam: hmm. can you paste the log? :eyes: 
Maya: ```INFO request_id=req_987 route=streamer session_id=abc123 tool_call=start tokens=120 connection=ok 
... 
INFO connection=reset reconnecting session_resume=abc123 toolcall_result=truncated tokens_charged=120 provisional=true```
Rachel: Sounds like we charged the toolcall tokens provisional, then on resume we re-applied prefix tokens? could be our resume path not deduping provisional credits.
Kevin: Are these the same offsets we saw in the session-handbook race? session rollback + toolcall atomicity problem.
Maya: Support says customer resumed within 3s and got an extra 120 tokens. console shows provisional->confirmed transition but ledger double-counted.
Sam: Repro steps? can we simulate with local router? i'll throw a canary.
Rachel: Also want to check trace ids: trace shows two distinct route ids because the router swapped region on reconnect. that may be why dedupe failed.
Kevin: So root cause hypothesis: reconnection route swap changes the `route_tag` so ledger treats it as new request and doesn't match provisional id. Proposal: include canonical session id (session_id) in route tags used by ledger for matching provisional credits.
Maya: Would that break sticky routing? maybe add to ledger dedupe key not route_tag.
Sam: Agree. Add `session_id` + `provisional_id` as dedupe keys. Also add a grace window for confirmation matching across route changes (30s).
Rachel: UX ask: in console, show provisional vs confirmed per-request and allow 'refund' flyout for confirmed duplicates. currently operators have to open billing ticket.
Billing-bot: FYI: if we change dedupe keys we'll need migrations for the provisional ledger indexer; plan ~2h of downtime for reindexing in Dedicated? :grimacing: 
Kevin: Let's scope: first add dedupe to runtime to avoid new occurrences, and emit metric `billing.provisional_mismatch` with tags (route_swap=true/false) so we can quantify.
Maya: I can prototype in router patch and add unit tests around resume + toolcall. Sam can add console PR for provisional line-item visibility.
Sam: I'll also add an alert when `billing.provisional_mismatch > 1/min` for prod for next 48h once canary hits.
Rachel: Nice. One more edge: toolcall TTLs — if toolcall TTL elapses before confirmation we currently tombstone provisional tokens. should confirm behavior doesn't cause undercharge when tombstone lost after resume.
Kevin: Good catch. Add integration test: resume after toolcall TTL expired -> ensure no double charge and no lost confirmed charge.
Maya: I'll drop a short RFC and link PRs here. thanks everyone :heart: 
Sam: thx! :thumbsup:
